title: Siman 288
section: The Greatness and Awesomeness of His Attainments

segments.he: אָמַרכָּל מַה שֶּׁמָּשִׁיחַ יַעֲשֶׂה טוֹבוֹת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנִי יָכוֹל לַעֲשׂוֹת, רַק
segments.en: (48.) He said: "Come, let us be grateful to the deceivers — for through the controversy they make against us we have come to great things, and they are doing us a great favor. For so it is that through controversy one comes and attains great things. As we find that our Rabbis of blessed memory said [Temurah 16a]: In the days of the mourning for Moses, three hundred laws were forgotten etc., and Joshua asked the Holy One Blessed be He, and He said: 'It is impossible to tell them to you — go and keep them busy with war.' And Osniel ben Kenaz restored them through his discernment. And Osniel...
